unit: Program on Law and Society in the Muslim World (Harvard HLS)

labs.lab_name: Program on Law and Society in the Muslim World
labs.pi_title: Faculty Director and Professor of Law
labs.research_summary: A Harvard Law School research program on how law and society relate in Muslim-majority and Muslim-minority settings, offering visiting fellowships and student research support.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 faculty director, 1 executive director, 1 writer and editor
labs.join_notes: Visiting Fellowships for scholars and practicing lawyers, one month to one academic year, stipend up to $5,000 a month. Applications for the general fellowship were closed when the page was updated; a call for 2027-2028 was to be announced in October 2026. A separate Tiruchelvam Memorial Fellowship page exists. Questions go to the program's general email.
labs.notes: Executive Director is Salma Waheedi. Not counted: 2 visiting fellows (Senuri de Silva, Zinnira Shaikh) and 6 student researchers. A second address on the page is for media inquiries. Emails decoded from the site's protected links.
